svg.text: ATOM · Architecture before & after
Structured work, inside the existing app
Pre-OMH baseline → current local implementation · 26 October 2026
BEFORE · main 1b6cc68
AFTER · local OMH integration
Chat, projects & saved history
Conversation continuity, selected models and access modes.
Same chat owner & durable history
No extra runtime; current model and grants stay authoritative.
Chat model + roles / skills
Existing chat routes requests to tools or native workers.
Selective research / build / review guides
Conservative routing; ordinary conversation stays direct.
Work plans & dependency order
Portions, bounded handoffs and two-worker concurrency.
Task contracts + bounded context
Deliverable, scope, check and stop condition per portion.
Gateway → Claude / Codex workers
Existing provider boundary; isolated worktrees where used.
Declared-scope admission → same Gateway
Dependency / overlap checks; shared retry-family reservations.
Checked tools & task reports
Permission checks, Stop, Git review and saved results.
Host evidence, separate from worker claims
Attempt IDs, inspection receipts and bounded file predicates.
Memory & existing task views
Reviewed facts, chat controls, Board and recovery records.
Explicit retry, repair review & recovery
Saved contracts; approved report handoff; no automatic replay.
SHARED FOUNDATION · retained on both sides
Native SwiftUI app + Node host · HelperStore / SQLite · Gateway · checked tools · saved permissions · Stop
Memory receipts now explain selection / delivery; existing notes, history and grants remain authoritative.
LIMITS & VALIDATION
New blocks describe implementation, not blanket acceptance or full OMH / Sentient parity.
File receipts are read-time snapshots, not tests. Repair accepts a report; it does not merge worktree files.
No Hermes bundle, automatic retry loop or measured speed/token improvement is claimed. See the acceptance note.
